summary: Recent updates to WebRTC, the technology behind video calls, have introduced important enhancements related to audio and transport statistics. The implementation of RTCTransportStats allows better tracking of bytes and packets sent and received during a call, which is essential for diagnosing connection quality. Additionally, improvements to the way audio data is processed, such as returning nsresult from the AudioPacketizer and safeguarding sample-count calculations, help ensure more reliable audio delivery in real-time communication. These changes matter because they contribute to a smoother and more efficient user experience during online conversations.
